shards.acceptance: Boundary extraction exists, has exactly bounded sources, and preserves required guarantees.
shards.question: Which old RedCap rules separate runtime root, project workspace, and user-private state?

shards.acceptance: Produces lifecycle evidence rules mapped to existing FSM transitions, not a second state machine.
shards.question: Which old review tracks are portable without duplicating the new FSM?

shards.acceptance: Produces shard split/acceptance rules and explicit anti-bulk-read limits.
shards.question: Which old long-task defenses should become Prism shard ledger rules?

shards.acceptance: Produces anti-pattern rules that distinguish useful reports from report-as-progress pathology, with no task-report body migration.
shards.question: Which old report rules helped verification, and which report mechanics let written reports substitute for changed reality?
shards.stop_condition: extract only report/progress semantics and guardrail candidates; do not read historical task-report bodies

shards.acceptance: Produces receipt semantics that keep receipts as proof after reality changes, never as completion itself.
shards.question: Which old receipt rules are useful proof chains, and which allowed receipts or aggregation to masquerade as completion?
shards.stop_condition: extract receipt/completion boundary only; do not inspect receipt archives or private task bodies

shards.acceptance: Produces closeout recursion limits and cut lines between closeout, implementation, and verification.
shards.question: Which old closeout mechanics are needed for safe recovery, and which created closeout work before implementation reality changed?
shards.stop_condition: extract closeout recursion and ownership limits only; do not execute old closeout scripts

shards.acceptance: Produces raw-evidence access limits that keep evidence queryable without making raw dumps default context.
shards.question: Which old evidence retention rules preserve proof, and which made raw evidence the default context surface?
shards.stop_condition: extract evidence-retention and context-default rules only; do not read raw prism runs or evidence archives
